question: Who became the oldest player to make a debut in men’s international cricket, appearing in a T20I match at the age of 62 years and 147 days in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andrew Brownlee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Andrew Brownlee** made history in **March 2025** by becoming the **oldest player** to make a debut in **men’s international cricket**.
 
• At the time of his **debut**, he was aged **62 years and 147 days**, surpassing all previous records across the recognized formats of the game.
 
• He achieved this milestone while representing **Greece** (the **Hellenic Cricket Federation**) in a **T20I (Twenty20 International)** match against **Bulgaria**.
 
• The match was part of an international bilateral series or regional tournament recognized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**. ***Hence, the statement regarding his age and debut is correct.***
